reviews_5s: So every kitchen should have one of these, it is so much easier and more convenient than dragging out some kind of motorized device or even that square cheese grater thingy that most people have that'll pretty much take the meat off your knuckles if you're not careful. Granted you're not going to shred up pounds of cheese with this but that's not the idea. You're looking for a little parmesan on top of your Italian dish or a little bit of cheese for flavor while you're cooking something, this is perfect. I've also used it to shred up or grate some ginger as anyone that's used Ginger knows that you don't really need a whole lot. It also works rather well for garlic however I have other methods for that. But yeah anyway this is one of those items that even if you don't really need it and you're just looking around Amazon because you're bored and you stumbled across this, it's not too expensive go ahead and buy it for yourself. You never know you might be doing something in the kitchen and suddenly realize and having this is the perfect tool for the job...This grater is sharp and easy to use. reviews_1s:
I got this for the size since I didn't want the full-size graters. The size is perfect but the edges are DULL. I never had a grater that I could easily rub my palm up and down without worrying about cutting myself. I guess it makes cleaning it easy. I've used dollar store graters that were sharper.

I would not recommend it.This grater was less than half the size of what I was expecting. Guess it will be good for something, but it’s too small to grate cheese with.I could have gotten one from dollar generalDo NOT waste your $! This is a plastic and flimsy aluminum piece of GARBAGE!Not practical. Save money and buy a real one. This one couldn’t even cut itself because of lousy this utensil is.This review is for Rainspire Professional Cheese Graters for Kitchen Stainless Steel Handheld, Metal Lemon Zester Grater With Handle For Cheese, Chocolate, Spices, Kitchen Gadgets And Tools, Soft Grip Handle, Black

I thought this might be a handy little grater for small jobs like shaving chocolate or zesting.

Right away, it's clear this is a very cheaply made item. The handle is plastic and supposed to have a "grip" handle. The handle is a slightly more matte texture than the rest of the plastic.

The actual metal plate is not a "full tang", and feels rather flimsily attached. I don't feel confident that it's not going to break and hurt me. It could be stainless steel, but it feels thin and cheap regardless.

The teeth are very dull and shallow. It doesn't zest well at all; it's just not sharp or deep enough to catch hold to shave juicy orange or lemon skins.

It's slightly more successful with a hard cheese like parmesan and slightly softer cheese like asiago. I haven't used it on much else because I don't like using it. It's unwieldy and it feels like I could easily slip and hurt myself.

This isn't a successful design and it's a shame, even at a cheap and/or steeply discounted price it's simply not worth it because it doesn't work well. The item I received is definitely not "professional" quality as is advertised in the title. Not recommended.the grates are not very sharp. Unable to zest citrus fruit. Was a pain to use to grate hard cheeses.

Worked ok with mild cheddar, but really this doesn't do what it advertises.
